title: Add @object-ui/types package - TypeScript protocol definitions
body:
## Plan: Define all @object-ui/types ✅ COMPLETE

- [x] Create packages/types directory structure
- [x] Define base schema types (BaseSchema, SchemaNode)
- [x] Define all layout component schemas (Container, Flex, Grid, Card, Tabs)
- [x] Define all form component schemas (Input, Button, Select, Checkbox, Form, etc.)
- [x] Define all data display component schemas (Table, DataTable, List, Badge, Avatar, Chart, etc.)
- [x] Define all feedback component schemas (Alert, Loading, Progress, Skeleton, Toast)
- [x] Define all disclosure component schemas (Accordion, Collapsible)
- [x] Define all overlay component schemas (Dialog, Sheet, Drawer, Popover, Tooltip, etc.)
- [x] Define all navigation component schemas (Header, Sidebar)
- [x] Define all complex component schemas (Kanban, Calendar, Timeline, FilterBuilder, etc.)
- [x] Define common types (ComponentInput, ComponentMeta, ComponentConfig)
- [x] Define data source types (DataSource interface)
- [x] Create package.json for @object-ui/types
- [x] Create tsconfig.json for @object-ui/types
- [x] Export all types from index.ts
- [x] Ensure ZERO dependencies (protocol-first design)
- [x] Build package successfully
- [x] Create comprehensive README documentation
- [x] Add usage examples
- [x] Address code review feedback (improve type safety, reduce duplication)
- [x] Fix CI build failure - update pnpm-lock.yaml
